summary: The root برر (brr) primarily signifies being good, righteous, or pious. It encompasses truthfulness, extensive goodness, and dutifulness, especially towards parents.

headwords.def: أَبَرٌّ [accord. to analogy signifies More, and most, pious &c.: see بَرٌّ . But the only meaning that I find assigned to it in any of the lexicons is that here following. ] More, and most, distant in the desert, (T, K,) as to habitation. (T.)
